service.ar: الاعتراض على رفض العلاج في الخارج
service.ur: بیرون ملک علاج کے فیصلے کے خلاف اپیل

about: Ask the committee to reconsider a rejected overseas treatment request.
aliases: إعادة النظر في طلب العلاج بالخارج
note: Requirements read from the official DHA service page on the checked date. DHA fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: File within 30 days of the first application
documents: A new medical report, if there is one
timing: 10 working days after the appeal is submitted
